rationale: The stock gapped down ~9% at the open and has since bounced from the session low of $21.50 to $22.57, placing price at 71% of today's range and above VWAP ($22.50) and the 9-EMA ($22.51) — suggesting the initial selling pressure has partially absorbed. However, the last five 1-minute candles show momentum stalling with declining volume and price oscillating in a tight $22.52–$22.60 band, offering no clear directional edge. With the ATR at only $0.12 on 5-minute bars, the risk/reward for either a long continuation or a short fade is insufficient to justify a position given the already realized loss today.
